name: Sable Faalele
role: Chemical and biological agent specialist — poisoner
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 60, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a poisoner out of Glassway, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
psychology.secret: Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "The best poison is the one nobody tests for."
"Patience, precision, and an understanding of human biology. Everything else is optional."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng's reputation — and a price for silence
A dead drop Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A corporate black site Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Tenzin Takahashi-Boateng is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes. Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander dominant (37.6%) with significant Indigenous American (26.0%) and Sub-Saharan African (19.3%) ancestry, blended with Hispanic/Latin American (10.6%), Eastern European (3.5%), and Northern European (3.0%) heritage. Genetic ancestry produces warm, rich medium-brown skin tone with undertones reflecting the Pacific Islander and African components, bone structure showing angular Indigenous American characteristics.
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, deceptively strong. Muscle density concentrated in core and legs from decades of augmentation integration. No wasted mass — economical, efficient.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural black undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. Practical. No decoration.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-dark brown with rich undertones — Pacific Islander and Sub-Saharan African ancestry creating deep, luminous base tone with slight golden warmth from Indigenous American heritage
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but not aged poorly. High cheekbones with angular definition characteristic of Indigenous American ancestry, strong jawline. Fine lines around eyes from squinting, not smiling. Skin carries a faint chemical sheen — occupational hazard, never quite washes out. Facial structure shows the blend of broad Pacific Islander features with sharper Indigenous American definition.
distinguishing_marks: Keloid scarring along both temples from neural interface installation — visible even with hair pulled back, jagged lines suggesting field work rather than clinic precision
Surgical scar along right jawline where vocal modulator was installed, partially concealed by bone structure but visible in profile
Faint chemical burns on fingertips and knuckles — discoloration, textured skin from years handling reactive compounds
Small tattoo on left inner wrist: three vertical lines in faded black ink, origin and meaning never explained
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Hydraulic joints at both knees and elbows — the chrome is evident, brushed steel finish with visible piston housings. No attempt at discretion or cosmetic covering. The joints move with mechanical precision, sometimes a hydraulic hiss when stress loads exceed threshold. Subdermal plating visible along her forearms when sleeves ride up — gray-metal sheen beneath skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical. Moves without flourish — each motion serves a purpose. Stands with weight balanced on the balls of feet, ready to shift. When seated, she maintains alertness rather than relaxation. Her movements carry a mechanical underlayer; the hydraulic joints have a subtle rhythm that marks her as augmented to anyone watching. No fidgeting. No nervous tells.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 transitional — pragmatic rather than aspirational. When in cover identity: neutral corporate-adjacent clothing, forgettable brands, nothing that draws attention. When working: dark fitted synthetics with reinforced seams and hidden pockets, matte finishes to avoid reflection. Favors jackets with high collars to partially conceal scarring. No jewelry except a simple analog watch — nothing wireless that could be traced or hacked. Boots with reinforced ankle support to accommodate hydraulic knee joints. Everything worn shows age; she maintains gear rather than replacing it.
